persona.label: Ravi, Service Engineer
persona.frequency: after every field visit with an out-of-pocket cost, offline-first, wants to get paid

goals: Capture a voucher draft on-site with photo proof even with no signal, and have it submit itself once connectivity returns
Track a submitted voucher through DRAFT/SUBMITTED/ZONAL_MANAGER_REVIEW/APPROVED/REJECTED/NEEDS_CLARIFICATION/PAID without calling the ZM
Fix and resubmit a REJECTED or NEEDS_CLARIFICATION voucher using the reviewer's stated reason
scopeNote: Money path crosses 3 roles / 2 phases: SE mobile (frequent, per-expense) -> ZM admin (queue review, daily-ish) -> OH admin (monthly Finance export + Mark PAID). No one persona owns the full lifecycle end to end - this module is a connected slice, not a single-owner surface, and control gaps at any handoff (SE->ZM, ZM->OH, OH->Finance) are as dangerous as gaps within one role's screen. CONTEXT.md's Expense Voucher entry describes the full 3-role lifecycle incl. Finance export as one concept; PRD lines 264-269 draw the module boundary as SE-only ('Service Engineer - Expense Vouchers'). Recorded, not resolved.

capabilities.name: Offline draft with mandatory photo proof
capabilities.why: no offline draft => Ravi cannot file on-site with poor plant connectivity, claim is lost or delayed a full cycle

capabilities.name: Draft-time client_submission_id dedup
capabilities.why: without draft-time id, a retried offline sync can double-submit => double reimbursement, a P1 control failure not just a UX bug

capabilities.name: Full status-ladder visibility incl. PAID
capabilities.why: without visible PAID/REJECTED state Ravi has no way to know his money moved except phoning the ZM

capabilities.name: Resubmit carries reviewer reason forward
capabilities.why: no carried reason => Ravi resubmits blind, claim stalls in a reject/clarify loop indefinitely

capabilities.name: ZM activity cross-check against Ticket at claimed plant/date
capabilities.why: this is the actual fraud control (CONTEXT.md 164) - without it ZM approves unverifiable claims on trust alone, P1

capabilities.name: Per-category configured limit enforcement, flagged not silently passed
capabilities.why: no limit flag => any amount clears review unexamined, no reconciliation baseline, P3

capabilities.name: Mandatory reason on Reject/Needs Clarification, captured in audit trail
capabilities.why: a denial with no recorded reason is unauditable money-adjacent action, P2

capabilities.name: Separation of duties: approver (ZM) != payer (OH)
capabilities.why: SPINE E-17: OH holds export+Mark PAID with no un-pay path - if the same actor could approve and pay, two-person control on cash movement collapses, P4

capabilities.name: PAID marking is reconciled against Finance's monthly batch, with no reversal path
capabilities.why: SPINE E-17 flags 'no un-pay path' explicitly DANGEROUS - a mis-marked PAID voucher has no correction route back to reconciliation, P3
